author: Pipefire
description: Sixteen free email deliverability tools by Pipefire, cold email software for agencies: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, BIMI and MTA-STS checks, spam blacklists, email headers, cold email and subject line scores, and SPF, DMARC and DKIM record generators. No account or API key.
name: Pipefire email deliverability tools

prompts.name: audit_domain
prompts.title: Audit a domain for email deliverability
prompts.description: Run every Pipefire check on a domain and get a prioritised fix list.

arguments.name: domain
arguments.description: The domain to audit, e.g. example.com.

prompts.name: why_spam
prompts.title: Why did this email go to spam?
prompts.description: Paste the headers of a message that landed in spam and find the cause.

arguments.name: headers
arguments.description: The raw headers of the message.

resources.name: guides
resources.title: Pipefire cold email and deliverability guides
resources.description: Every published Pipefire guide, with its URL and a one-line summary.

tools.name: check_domain_email_setup
tools.title: Email authentication check (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
tools.description: Check whether a domain is set up to send and receive email properly: MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC in one go, each with pass/warn/fail, what was found, and how to fix it. Use when someone asks why their email goes to spam, whether their domain is set up right, or before sending cold email.

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. example.com.

selector.description: DKIM selector if known. Common ones are tried automatically.

tools.name: check_dmarc
tools.title: DMARC check
tools.description: Check a domain's DMARC record: whether one exists at _dmarc, its policy (none, quarantine, reject), whether reports are collected, and outdated tags. Tells you whether the domain can be impersonated by email.

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. example.com. A URL or email address also works.

tools.name: check_spf
tools.title: SPF check
tools.description: Check a domain's SPF record: whether it exists, is valid, stays under the 10 DNS lookup limit, and ends with a sensible all mechanism.

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. example.com. A URL or email address also works.

tools.name: check_dkim
tools.title: DKIM check
tools.description: Look up a domain's DKIM public key, trying the selectors Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and common senders use, plus one you name.

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. example.com. A URL or email address also works.

selector.description: DKIM selector if known (e.g. google, selector1). Common ones are tried automatically.

tools.name: check_mx
tools.title: MX lookup
tools.description: List a domain's mail servers (MX records) and which provider handles its email.

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. example.com. A URL or email address also works.

tools.name: check_bimi
tools.title: BIMI check
tools.description: Check a domain's BIMI record (logo in the inbox) and whether its DMARC policy is strict enough for BIMI to show.

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. example.com. A URL or email address also works.

tools.name: check_mta_sts
tools.title: MTA-STS check
tools.description: Check a domain's MTA-STS policy, which forces encrypted delivery of incoming mail.

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. example.com. A URL or email address also works.

tools.name: check_blacklists
tools.title: Email blacklist check
tools.description: Check whether a domain's sending IPs, or a single IPv4 address, are listed on the major email blacklists (Spamhaus, Barracuda, SpamCop and others), with removal links.

target.description: A domain (example.com) or a public IPv4 address.

tools.name: analyze_email_headers
tools.title: Email header analyzer
tools.description: Read the raw headers of a received email: SPF, DKIM and DMARC results, alignment, the delivery path and delays. Use when someone pastes headers and asks why a message went to spam or failed authentication.

headers.description: The raw email headers (the part above the message body).

tools.name: check_cold_email
tools.title: Cold email checker
tools.description: Score a cold email (subject and body) out of 10 against the rules Pipefire checks its own emails with: length, reading level, the ask, subject line, and spam-filter wording. Returns each issue with why it matters and how to fix it.

kind.description: Which email in the sequence. Default first.

tools.name: test_subject_line
tools.title: Subject line tester
tools.description: Score a cold email subject line out of 10: length, wording that hurts opens, and spam trigger words, with fixes.

tools.name: suggest_sending_domains
tools.title: Sending domain generator
tools.description: Suggest lookalike sending domains for cold email (so the main domain is never put at risk), with live .com/.net availability. Give a business name or its website.

brand.description: Business name (Acme Roofing) or main domain (acmeroofing.com).

tools.name: guess_email_addresses
tools.title: Email permutator
tools.description: List the likely email address formats for a person at a company domain (first@, first.last@, flast@ ...). Guesses only: verify before sending.

tools.name: generate_spf_record
tools.title: SPF record generator
tools.description: Build a valid SPF TXT record for a domain from the email services it sends with, with warnings about the 10-lookup limit.

providers.description: Mailbox providers: google (Google Workspace), microsoft (Microsoft 365), zoho (Zoho Mail), zoho-eu (Zoho Mail (EU data center)).

includes.description: Other include: domains, e.g. sendgrid.net, mailgun.org.

strict.description: true = -all (hard fail), false = ~all (soft fail, the safer default).

tools.name: generate_dmarc_record
tools.title: DMARC record generator
tools.description: Build a valid DMARC TXT record (to publish at _dmarc.yourdomain) from a policy and report addresses.

policy.description: Start with none plus a report address, then tighten.

tools.name: generate_dkim_record
tools.title: DKIM record generator
tools.description: Format a DKIM public key as the TXT record to publish at selector._domainkey.yourdomain.

publicKey.description: The public key, PEM or bare base64.
